fields.summary_ko.0: Marvell (MRVL) raised its FY2028 revenue guidance from $18 billion to $20 billion in early October, with the current stock price of $248 representing a -21% undervaluation compared to the June high of $316.43.
fields.summary_ko.1: The forward P/E based on FY2028 expected EPS is 34x, with data center revenue accounting for 79% of total revenue and growing 46% YoY, though concentration risk exists as the top 10 customers comprise 82% of total revenue.
